resources.string: This application allows you to create custom resolution and density profiles for your games to improve performance. IMPORTANT: Shizuku must be activated. The app uses Shizuku\'s temporary root privileges to safely execute system commands. by TechViva liclopes@gmail.com
Disables thermal throttling to prevent the system from reducing CPU/GPU speed when the device gets hot.
Disables hardware overlays to give the game direct access to the GPU for rendering.
Automatically clears the game\'s cache directory before launching to ensure a fresh start.
Sets the game process priority to be immune to the Android OOM Killer, preventing it from being closed in the background.
